Getting started

  1. In your pattern library, tap New Pattern (+). Choose a photo from your library, take one with the camera, or pick an emoji.
  2. Tap Pattern to choose your bead brand, the pattern size, dithering and your pegboard size. The pattern updates behind the sheet as you change things.
  3. Tap Build to place beads row by row. Tap beads as you place them to keep your place.
  4. Open ••• → Bead List for exact bead counts per color before you shop.

Patterns and colors

Which bead brands are included?

MARD (213 colors), Artkal C (174), Artkal S (176), Artkal A (145), Artkal M (220, the same codes as MARD), Perler (95), Hama Midi (92, also sold as IKEA PYSSLA), Hama Mini (78), Hama Maxi (25) and Nabbi (30).

To use only the beads you own, open ••• → Settings → Set Up My Beads….

The colors don't look like my photo

Every pixel is matched to the nearest real bead color in the palette you picked. Things to try:

  • Switch to a palette with more colors, such as MARD or Artkal M.
  • Change Dithering in the Pattern sheet. Error-diffusion modes (Floyd–Steinberg, Atkinson, Burkes, Stucki) smooth gradients; ordered (Bayer) dithering gives a regular texture; no dithering gives flat areas of color.
  • Use a larger pattern size, so small details get more beads.
  • After converting, tap Edit to paint, fill, replace or erase single beads, with undo and redo.

How many beads should I buy?

Open ••• → Bead List. It gives exact counts per color with a 10% spare margin, and you can export it as a CSV for ordering.

My shop sells a different brand

Open ••• → Convert Palette to see the nearest match in another brand for every color, rated exact, close or approximate. You can export the table as CSV.

My pattern is bigger than one pegboard

Choose a board size in the Pattern sheet (29×29, 30×30, 40×40, 48×48, 50×50, or 57×57 for 2.6 mm mini beads). Larger patterns are split across boards with seam guides, and Build moves board by board. Any custom size is free; sizing a pattern to exactly 2×2 or 3×3 pegboards in one tap is part of Beadify Pro.

Printing and exporting

Use ••• → Print to send the chart to any AirPrint printer, or export it as a PDF or PNG. The board-by-board PDF, with one page per pegboard and bead codes in every cell, is part of Beadify Pro.

Saving and syncing

Patterns save automatically. If you're signed in to iCloud, they sync to your other iPhone, iPad and Mac through your private iCloud account. No Beadify account is needed.

Beadify Pro

Every feature above is free. Beadify Pro is an optional one-time purchase, with no subscription. It adds:

  • the board-by-board PDF
  • multi-board patterns: size a pattern to 2×2 or 3×3 pegboards in one tap
  • cleanup tools: limit a pattern to fewer colors, remove a photo's background, and clean up stray beads
  • no banner ad on iPhone and iPad
  • new Pro features as they arrive, in the same purchase

I bought Pro, but it isn't showing

Open ••• → Settings → Beadify Pro and tap Restore Purchases. Pro works on every device signed in with the same Apple Account.

I bought Remove Ads or Beadify 1.7

You already have Pro. If it isn't showing, use Restore Purchases as above.

Refunds

Apple handles all payments and refunds. Request one at reportaproblem.apple.com.

Ads and privacy

On iPhone and iPad, the free version shows a small banner ad. Where the law requires it, you're asked for consent first; change your choice any time under ••• → Settings → Privacy Choices. Your photos and patterns never leave your device and iCloud. The privacy policy has the details.
